text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us came to the shrine with Hishi Miracle,
who hasn't been doing well lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bow before passing through the torii gate.
Avoid walking down the center of the path, got it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I studied beforehand so as not
to be disrespectful to the gods.
Next is offering our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bow... one, two bows.
Next, two claps.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Dear gods, please lend me your strength
so that I can feel better...!
I beg of you, please...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When in trouble, turn to the gods, right?
I hope the gods grant my wish.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Would you like to draw
a fortune slip and see what the future holds for you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I wonder what's gonna come out~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after drawing fortune slips
with Hishi Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, both of us got Great Blessing!
Could this be our prayers
bearing fruit already?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, as expected of "Great Blessing,"
it only had wonderful things written on it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wishes: will come true with effort.
Luck in competition: good chance for a turnaround, go all-in.
Health: no issues, apparently!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"My future is super bright, isn't it?
Man, I'm really looking forward to it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps buoyed by the good fortune from the omikuji,
Hishi Miracle managed to get back into top form.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Both the Trainer and I got... terrible luck...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe they thought I was being calculating,
only relying on them when I'm in trouble...
*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having drawn Terrible Luck, Hishi Miracle was thoroughly bummed out
and couldn't manage to get back into top shape either.
